stem.text: An object slides with constant velocity across a horizontal sheet of ice. Friction is negligible.
A constant horizontal force of $2.1\,\text{N}$ is then applied to the object as shown.

stem.alt: Vertical arrow pointing upwards, labelled initial direction of motion of object.
Horizontal arrow labelled 2.1 N pointing at a small circle labelled object; a diagonal arrow at 30° to a dashed horizontal line, labelled 4.0 m and ending at point X.

stem.text: A short time after applying the force, the object reaches point X at a displacement of $4.0\,\text{m}$ from its position when the force was first applied.
What is the work done by the force on the object as it travels to point X?
